card.name: Table and list markers in web text
card.fires_on: Structural slots in tables, infoboxes and numbered lists: the label word in an infobox row, or a digit or separator at the start of a list item or table cell.

modes.label: Infobox labels
modes.description: Label words inside pipe-separated infobox rows, such as origin or significant.

modes.label: List or table digits
modes.description: A digit starting a numbered step or the first digit of a number in a table cell.
